title: Specialist finding fragment
description: What each specialist skill writes after analyzing the shared snapshot (or probing in standalone URL mode). Scripts emit observations; the skill's instructions decide gates and complete candidate_finding per severity_model.md. The orchestrator's build_report.py assigns F-ids, dedups root causes, normalizes severity/confidence, and validates. Specialists never assign report ids and never fetch the site twice in composed mode.

not_evaluated.description: Checks this specialist could not run and why (capability, deadline, robots-blocked probe). Never a finding.

evidence_quality.description: Maps to severity_model.md confidence: high <- direct-*; medium <- indirect-corroborated, semantic-judgment; low <- hypothesis (goes to needs_verification, not findings)

observations.description: Raw measured values - numbers, booleans, quoted strings. No prose conclusions.

candidate_finding.description: Required when gate == 'finding'. Completed by the model following severity_model.md.

affected_surfaces.description: citation + live-fetch surfaces only (see provider_registry.json surface_taxonomy); training surfaces are evidence, never an affected surface

acceptance_test.description: site-specific test proving the fix; the specialist writes it here - build_report.py fills from the playbook only when absent
